f5dd6c61-75e5-47be-89e8-68ea8753b8cd.quote: Revenant finished with 13 kills, nine of them on Kira and Steel, and the most hero damage in the game. Our best stretch was a 4-1 teamfight followed by Fangtooth and two of their outer towers. Both teamfights after that went their way: the first went 2-4, with an inner tower, Orb Prime and both inhibitors falling after it, and the second went 1-3 shortly before the Core fell. They turned six of their eight won fights into prizes; we turned two of five.
f5dd6c61-75e5-47be-89e8-68ea8753b8cd.issue: 'both inhibitors' implies the base has only two; the source records two inhibitors lost on a three-lane map
f5dd6c61-75e5-47be-89e8-68ea8753b8cd.rewrite: Revenant finished with 13 kills, nine on Kira and Steel, and the most hero damage in the game. The best stretch for the team was a 4-1 teamfight followed by Fangtooth and two enemy outer towers. Both later teamfights went the enemy's way: the first went 2-4, with an inner tower, Orb Prime and two inhibitors falling after that fight, and the second went 1-3 shortly before the Core fell. The enemy turned six of eight won fights into prizes; the team turned two of five.

f5dd6c61-75e5-47be-89e8-68ea8753b8cd.quote: We took their outer tower in this window, but Steel, Kira and Riktor died while we got one kill on Aurora, and the Core fell shortly after. With both inhibitors gone, staying alive to defend outranks any tower.
